name: InterContinental Costa Rica at Multiplaza Mall
positioning: An InterContinental in Escazú, San José's commercial district, next door to Multiplaza Mall, with heated outdoor pools in palm-filled gardens, a spa with outdoor bamboo palapas and a private-entrance Club Tower
best_for: Travelers who want a San José city base next door to Multiplaza Mall
Guests wanting the privacy of the Club Tower

facts.text: Multiplaza Mall is right next door to the hotel, in the Escazú district.
The hotel is in Escazú, in San José's commercial district.
Guests can explore nearby coffee estates and the galleries and boutiques of Avenida Escazú.
Guest rooms have views of the mountains, gardens or city.
The heated outdoor pools are set amid the greenery and swaying palms of the hotel's gardens, with poolside beverage and light-menu service.
The pool area includes a children's pool and a whirlpool.
The spa offers individual or couples treatments, and private pools for a soothing soak.
The spa's outdoor bamboo palapas offer an intimate, candlelit escape.
The spa offers restoration shaped by local traditions and global expertise.
The Club Tower is a secluded level with a private entrance, reserved for the hotel's most loyal guests.
Zambra, the lobby bar, serves tapas-style dishes with live music.
At The Market, guests can eat on a terrace alongside the pool and gardens.

considerations.text: Juan Santamaria Airport (SJO) is approximately 15 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the urban mall setting lacks a traditional Costa Rican atmosphere.
